title: Improved Vanilla Recipes
description: Adds multiple QoL recipes and extras such as craftable nametags, block uncrafting, additional stonecutting recipes and more.
body:
# Improved Vanilla Recipes
Improved Vanilla Recipes adds multiple quality of life recipes for Smelting, Blasting, Crafting and Stonecutting such as being able to **convert slabs back into blocks**, **smelting raw ore blocks**, **uncraft certain items**, **craftable Name Tags and Saddles**, etc.

Additonally, check out **[Goat Horn Sound Conversion](https://modrinth.com/datapack/goat-horn-conversion)**, which **lets you exchange any Goat Horn variant into a desired one**!

## Features
This datapack is compatible with JEI and similar recipe-lookup mods.  
Crafting patterns are also displayed in the in-game recipe book.

<details>
<summary>Crafting</summary>
  
All of the following items can now be crafted. If an item was already craftable, an alternative crafting recipe has been added.
- Amethyst Cluster
- Brown Dye (With Dye mixing or with Brown Mushroom Block + Brown Mushroom)
- Brown Mushroom Block
- Chainmail Armor
- Cobweb
- Glow Lichen
- Green Dye (With Dye mixing or with Moss Block)
- Lead (With Strings and Iron Nugget)
- Moss Block
- Mossy Blocks (With Moss Carpets)
- Mycelium
- Name Tag (Respects version 26.1 recipe)
- Nether Brick
- Red Mushroom Block
- Saddle (Respects version 1.21.6 recipe)
- Warped Wart Block  

![Chainmail Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ac432f1457cabfa9f31b6679203f8dc95efb2a1.png)
![Nametag Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc28a3d8c3d843dce74a7745c206d216d015e018.png)
![Saddle Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dc28475449905172a3b99ab4ce0601aa1ed01d70.png)

</details>

<details>
<summary>Uncrafting</summary>

Uncrafting items can be done by simply putting the singular item in any crafting table.  

The following items return partial materials, for example one door will only return 2 planks, but 3 doors will return the whole material used to craft those doors.
- Any type of doors
- Any type of walls
- Any type of trapdoors
- Any type of slabs
- Any type of books (Returns leather only)  

![Partial Material Return](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f635a88dd16b6b2dff19283eb4338fbf3ac6055.png)
![Slab to Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7083a40217b0048ad5123dd5cfe974b1357d0c79.png)
![Slab to Block (alt)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/39a3b8e20ff4ddf928f8051b5d215798cb18ef15.png)

The following items return full materials, for example wool will return 4 string, therefore returns the whole material.
- Amethyst Block
- Blue Ice
- Bricks
- Brown Mushroom Block
- Clay
- Cobweb
- Dead Bush
- Filled Map
- Glowstone
- Honeycomb Block
- Magma Block
- Nether Bricks
- Nether Wart Block
- Packed Ice
- Polished Blocks
- Purpur Block
- Quartz Block
- Red Mushroom Block
- Saplings
- Snow Block
- Turtle Shell
- Warped Wart Block
- Wolf Armor
- Wool  

![Full Material Return (4)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/220c8ac23ff01f9a35b6625303b8fe1befed5223.png)
![Full Material Return (9)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1d48a990ffd115cc293e456e5024710ca06fefc5.png)
</details>

<details>
<summary>Smelting & Blasting</summary>

Certain blocks can be now smelted to maintain material continuity, such as Stone Slabs being smelted into Smooth Stone Slabs.  

The following items **can only be smelted**.
- Cobblestone Slab
- Cobblestone Stairs
- Quartz Slab
- Quartz Stairs
- Red Sandstone Slab
- Red Sandstone Stairs
- Sandstone Slab
- Sandstone Stairs
- Stone Slab  

![Stone Slab Smelting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d50c3aee0fa1bc1bea8ee35512bd1f0e479d28a.png)
![Sandstone Stairs Smelting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/966e763106b9d1d2329764500fc2a71fc08e1d72.png)

The following items **can be smelted and blasted**.
- Raw Copper Block
- Raw Gold Block
- Raw Iron Block  

![Raw Iron Blasting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e06caf9d5bbd6020928e1b1c8a29e40a86b8e21.png)
![Raw Iron Smelting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f8d129c1ed3c6783bd5ffbabe218e67a78fe0f1c.png)
</details>

<details>
<summary>Stonecutting</summary>

The following recipes have been added to stonecutters, these will only work with stonecutter compatible blocks.
- Bamboo Block to x9 Bamboo
- Stone to Cobblestone & Other Variants
- Deepslate to Cobbled Deepslate & Other Variants
- Stairs to Slabs

![Deepslate Stonecutting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/727977d3129dce9baebb5431280e083745b7a277.png)
![Stone Stonecutting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aa5e904681643dbc8b41f47dfb8799e13dcde885.png)
![Cobblestone to other variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c4b771dbfe884b08ca139ef7126945ce0cc0571c.png)
</details>

<details>
<summary>Copper Oxidization</summary>

Any non-waxed copper block can now have their oxidization increased by one stage by combining the desired block with a Water Bucket.  

![Oxidization Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0448160913481863936078435195eb90c213e35e.png)  
*Due to technical limitations, this process will consume the water inside the bucket and increase the oxidization stage to ***only one block****.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Coral Reviving</summary>

Any Coral block, Coral and Coral Fans can now be revived by combining the desired coral with a Water Bucket.  

![Tube Coral Block Revival](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/85d7be79e57503333d08d50b2a41d4a419e76bb4.png)
![Bubble Coral Revival](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c615bf465bcdfc30df024182a30655a41a2d59dc.png)
![Fire Coral Fan Revival](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0418ee9cc1ad7b1136f302c8b0e0c6259d0a3a59.png)  
*Due to technical limitations, this process will consume the water inside the bucket and revive ***only one block****.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Sherd Duping</summary>

Every single obtainable sherd can now be duplicated by combining a desired sherd with bricks.

![Sherd Duplication Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5dbd56b6e1f3b7405f5fe43af39715bee8b578f6.png)

</details>

**This datapack was only tested for 1.21.1 and is likely only compatible with 1.21.1 and 1.21**
